flops_method: Training FLOPs per token as implemented: 3 x forward; forward = 2 x (matmul weights, the tied V/O map counted twice, readout V x d once) + causal attention 2 x 2 x (T/2) x dh per head-layer. Embedding lookups, norms and softmax are excluded.
label: Wang et al. (position-only GD, parameter-matched)
deviations_from_wang_et_al: parameter-matched: depth (number of GD layers) chosen to match the Transformer total
one learned positional-covariate table shared by all GD layers (width cov_dim), unit-RMS init
tied QK and tied V/O (W_O = W_V^T) per head, softmax kernel normalized over examples i < t
zero-mean tied embeddings and gainless RMS readout, as in gdlm
Llama-2 / Llama-3.2 tokenizers, FineWeb-Edu, 2048 context, document-masked kernels
